title: FlexCore — telemetry ingestion pipeline
description: P11.09 dashboard-as-code (Phase 11 wave 1, Agent B). The P2.21 telemetry families already in the registry, referenced by name only (they are not re-declared — the P11.01 record's rule). No panel invents a metric. WRITTEN-UNRUN.

panels.title: Telemetry domain events by frozen type (flexcore_telemetry_events_total)
panels.description: The closed §15.3 telemetry event vocabulary; unknown types are never counted (deny-by-default extends to labels).

panels.title: Bounded-channel depth (flexcore_telemetry_queue_depth)
panels.description: The ingestion backlog at the last observation; shedding with retry (never silent drop) is the backpressure contract.

panels.title: Quarantined records by closed reason class (flexcore_telemetry_quarantine_by_reason_total)
panels.description: The free-text quarantine reason is never a label (recorded cardinality decision).

panels.title: Stored records by canonical quality state (flexcore_telemetry_quality_states_total)
panels.description: All six canonical states render, zero included (P0.08 vocabulary; exactly one state per value).

panels.title: Mean ingestion delay, ms (flexcore_telemetry_ingestion_delay_milliseconds)
panels.description: Per-batch summary (ingest_time - event_time); the per-asset breakdown lives in the logs, never in labels (recorded cardinality decision).
